test_cases.test_name: Document Assignment and Automated Reminder Functionality Test
test_cases.objective: Verify the system can correctly assign documents to users/groups and trigger automated reminders as per the vendor scheduler.
prerequisites: Test user accounts and groups are created
Test document is loaded into the system
Vendor scheduler is configured for reminders

test_steps.action: Log into the system with administrator credentials and navigate to the document assignment module.
test_steps.expected_result: Administrator dashboard loads successfully, and the document assignment interface is accessible.

test_steps.action: Select a test document and assign it to a pre-defined test user group using the vendor UI.
test_steps.expected_result: System confirms the assignment is successful and the document appears in the assigned list for the group.

test_steps.action: Verify the assignment appears in the test user's dashboard and requires acknowledgment.
test_steps.expected_result: Test user can see the assigned document with a status of 'Pending Acknowledgment'.

test_steps.action: Wait for the scheduled reminder time or manually trigger the reminder function.
test_steps.expected_result: System sends an automated reminder notification (e.g., email, system alert) to users with pending acknowledgments.
data_to_capture: Screenshot or log of the sent reminder

acceptance_criteria: Document assignment is completed successfully via the vendor UI.
Assigned documents are visible to the target users/groups.
Automated reminders are generated and sent according to the scheduler configuration.
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures
Annex 11 - Computerised Systems
data_integrity_requirements: Assignment records must be complete and accurate.
Audit trail must record the assignment action and user.

test_cases.test_name: Acknowledgment Reporting and Audit Trail Verification
test_cases.objective: Validate the generation of standard acknowledgment reports and the integrity of the audit trail for assignment and acknowledgment events.
prerequisites: Test document assignments exist from OQ-001
Test user has acknowledged at least one document

test_steps.action: Log in as a manager with reporting privileges and navigate to the standard acknowledgment reports section.
test_steps.expected_result: Manager dashboard and reporting interface load successfully.

test_steps.action: Generate a standard acknowledgment report for the test user group, filtering for the recent test period.
test_steps.expected_result: Report is generated in less than 10 seconds and displays the assignment and acknowledgment status for the test document and users.
data_to_capture: Time taken to generate the report

test_steps.action: Verify the report data matches the test actions performed (e.g., user assignment, acknowledgment status, timestamps).
test_steps.expected_result: Report accurately reflects all test activities, including pending and completed acknowledgments.
data_to_capture: Comparison log between test actions and report data

test_steps.action: Access the audit trail for the test document and review the entries for assignment and acknowledgment events.
test_steps.expected_result: Audit trail contains immutable, timestamped records for the assignment creation and the user's electronic signature acknowledgment.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of relevant audit trail entries

acceptance_criteria: Standard acknowledgment reports are generated within the required performance time (<10s).
Reports provide accurate and complete data on assignment and acknowledgment status.
Audit trail contains a secure, unalterable record of all critical actions.
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e) - Audit Trails
EU GMP Annex 11 - Chapter 9 - Audit Trails
data_integrity_requirements: Report data must be accurate, complete, and consistent with system records.
Audit trail must be secure, time-stamped, and cannot be disabled.

test_cases.test_name: Performance Testing: High Volume Document Assignments and Reporting
test_cases.objective: Verify the system can handle 10,000 document assignments per day and generate reports in under 10 seconds for 50,000 records as specified in URS-021-008 and URS-021-009.
prerequisites: Test environment with vendor software installed
Test dataset of 50,000+ document acknowledgment records

test_steps.action: Using automated scripts, create 10,000 document assignments to various test users within a 24-hour period
test_steps.expected_result: System successfully processes all assignments without errors or performance degradation

test_steps.action: Execute standard acknowledgment report generation for 50,000 records using vendor reporting interface
test_steps.expected_result: Report generation completes in less than 10 seconds with all data accurately displayed
data_to_capture: System resource usage during report generation

acceptance_criteria: All 10,000 assignments processed successfully within 24 hours
Report generation completes in under 10 seconds
No system crashes or critical errors during testing
regulatory_basis: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements
EU Annex 11 computerised systems requirements
data_integrity_requirements: All assignment and acknowledgment records must be complete and accurate
No data loss during high volume processing
Report data must match source records exactly
related_tests: OQ-001: Document Assignment and Automated Reminder Functionality Test

test_cases.test_name: Integration Testing: Active Directory User Group Synchronization
test_cases.objective: Verify the standard AD connector successfully synchronizes user groups from Active Directory to the document acknowledgment system as specified in URS-021-010.
prerequisites: Test environment with vendor software installed
Test user groups configured in AD

test_steps.action: Create new test user groups in Active Directory with specific naming conventions
test_steps.expected_result: Groups are successfully created in Active Directory with proper permissions

test_steps.action: Execute the vendor-provided AD synchronization process using standard connector
test_steps.expected_result: System successfully imports user groups from Active Directory without errors

test_steps.action: Verify imported groups are available for document assignment in the vendor UI
test_steps.expected_result: All synchronized groups appear in the document assignment interface with correct membership
data_to_capture: Membership accuracy compared to AD source

acceptance_criteria: All test AD groups successfully synchronized to document system
Group membership accurately reflected in both systems
Synchronization process completes without manual intervention
regulatory_basis: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 access controls
GAMP5 for integration of COTS systems
data_integrity_requirements: Group data must be synchronized accurately without corruption
Membership changes in AD must propagate to document system
No unauthorized access through synchronization process
related_tests: OQ-001: Document Assignment and Automated Reminder Functionality Test

test_cases.test_name: Role-Based Dashboard Verification for Document Acknowledgment Tracking
test_cases.objective: To verify that role-based dashboards correctly display document acknowledgment status and metrics for different user roles (e.g., Manager, User) as per the vendor's standard functionality.
prerequisites: Test users with different roles (Manager, Standard User) are created
Documents have been assigned to users for acknowledgment
Some acknowledgment activities have been completed

test_steps.action: Log into the system as a user with Manager role credentials.
test_steps.expected_result: Dashboard displays manager-specific metrics (e.g., overall completion %, pending acknowledgments by user/group).

test_steps.action: Navigate to the dashboard section showing pending document acknowledgments for the manager's assigned groups.
test_steps.expected_result: List of documents pending acknowledgment by users in the manager's groups is displayed correctly.
data_to_capture: List of pending documents and assigned users

test_steps.action: Log out and log in as a standard user. Navigate to the user dashboard.
test_steps.expected_result: Dashboard displays user-specific view showing documents assigned to them and their acknowledgment status.

test_steps.action: Verify that the user cannot access managerial reporting or user management functions.
test_steps.expected_result: User is restricted from accessing functions outside their role permissions.
data_to_capture: List of attempted and restricted functions

acceptance_criteria: Dashboard correctly filters information based on user role
Manager dashboard provides comprehensive oversight metrics
User dashboard provides personalized document status
Role-based access control prevents unauthorized access to functions
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Limited access to authorized individuals
Annex 11 - Privileges for personnel relevant to their responsibilities
data_integrity_requirements: Dashboard data must accurately reflect current acknowledgment status from the database
Role permissions must be consistently enforced across all dashboard functions
urs_requirements: URS-021-004: Provide role-based dashboards for managers

test_cases.test_name: Electronic Signature Verification for Document Acknowledgment
test_cases.objective: To verify that the vendor-provided electronic acknowledgment signature process meets regulatory requirements for electronic records and signatures.
prerequisites: Test user account is created and active
Test document is assigned to the test user for acknowledgment

test_steps.action: Log into the system as a test user who has pending document acknowledgments.
test_steps.expected_result: User successfully logs in and can view assigned documents requiring acknowledgment.

test_steps.action: Select a document for acknowledgment and initiate the electronic signature process.
test_steps.expected_result: System prompts for electronic signature with required fields (e.g., username, password, meaning of signature).

test_steps.action: Complete the electronic signature process by entering credentials and confirming acknowledgment.
test_steps.expected_result: System records the acknowledgment with timestamp and user identity, and document status updates to 'Acknowledged'.

test_steps.action: Verify the audit trail entry for the acknowledgment event contains all required elements.
test_steps.expected_result: Audit trail shows timestamp, user identity, action taken (acknowledgment), and document identifier.

acceptance_criteria: Electronic signature process captures required regulatory elements
Acknowledgment records are permanently linked to user identity
Audit trail contains complete record of acknowledgment event
Signature process cannot be bypassed or altered
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11.10 - Controls for identification codes/passwords
21 CFR Part 11.50 - Signature manifestations
21 CFR Part 11.70 - Signature/record linking
data_integrity_requirements: Electronic signatures must be uniquely linked to their respective records
Signed records must be protected from alterations after signing
Signature manifestations must be permanently associated with their signed records
urs_requirements: URS-021-005: Support vendor-provided electronic acknowledgment signature
URS-021-007: Provide audit trail for assignments and acknowledgments

test_cases.test_name: Audit Trail Verification for Document Assignment and Acknowledgment
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system maintains a complete and unalterable audit trail for all document assignment and acknowledgment activities as required by regulatory standards.
prerequisites: Test users with appropriate permissions are created
Test documents are available in the system

test_steps.action: Assign a test document to multiple users using the vendor UI and record the assignment details
test_steps.expected_result: Document is successfully assigned to users and assignment is recorded in the system

test_steps.action: Have test users acknowledge the assigned document using electronic signature functionality
test_steps.expected_result: Users successfully acknowledge the document and electronic signatures are recorded

test_steps.action: Access the system's audit trail reports and search for the assignment and acknowledgment events
test_steps.expected_result: All assignment and acknowledgment events are recorded in the audit trail with complete details

test_steps.action: Verify the integrity and immutability of the audit trail records by attempting to modify any entry
test_steps.expected_result: Audit trail entries cannot be modified or deleted by any user, maintaining data integrity

acceptance_criteria: All document assignment events are recorded in the audit trail with complete metadata
All acknowledgment events with electronic signatures are captured in the audit trail
Audit trail entries are immutable and cannot be modified or deleted
Audit trail contains timestamp, user ID, action type, and document ID for each event
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures
Annex 11 - Computerized Systems
FDA Data Integrity Guidance
data_integrity_requirements: ALCOA+ principles must be maintained for all audit trail entries
Audit trail must be time-stamped and user-attributed
Records must be maintained per retention policy requirements
Audit trail must be secure and tamper-evident
urs_requirements: URS-021-006: Maintain acknowledgment records per retention policy
URS-021-007: Provide audit trail for assignments and acknowledgments
related_tests: OQ-002: Acknowledgment Reporting and Audit Trail Verification
OQ-006: Electronic Signature Verification for Document Acknowledgment

test_cases.test_name: Retention Policy Compliance for Acknowledgment Records
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system properly maintains acknowledgment records according to the defined retention policy and prevents premature deletion.
prerequisites: Retention policy is configured in the system
Test documents with acknowledgment records exist

test_steps.action: Review the configured retention policy settings for acknowledgment records in the system
test_steps.expected_result: Retention policy is properly configured with appropriate duration and archiving settings

test_steps.action: Create test acknowledgment records with known dates that span different retention periods
test_steps.expected_result: Test records are successfully created with proper timestamps and metadata

test_steps.action: Attempt to manually delete acknowledgment records that are within the retention period
test_steps.expected_result: System prevents deletion of records that are still within the retention period

test_steps.action: Verify that records beyond the retention period are properly handled according to policy (archived or flagged for deletion)
test_steps.expected_result: System correctly identifies and handles records that have exceeded the retention period

acceptance_criteria: System prevents deletion of acknowledgment records within the retention period
Records beyond retention period are properly archived or flagged for deletion
Retention policy settings are enforced consistently
All retention actions are recorded in the audit trail
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Record retention requirements
EU GMP Annex 11 - Data retention
FDA Guidance on Data Integrity
data_integrity_requirements: Records must be maintained for the full retention period without alteration
Deletion of records must follow approved procedures and be documented
Archiving processes must maintain data integrity and accessibility
Retention policy compliance must be verifiable through reporting
urs_requirements: URS-021-006: Maintain acknowledgment records per retention policy
URS-021-007: Provide audit trail for assignments and acknowledgments
related_tests: OQ-002: Acknowledgment Reporting and Audit Trail Verification
OQ-007: Audit Trail Verification for Document Assignment and Acknowledgment

test_steps.expected_result: System processes all 10,000 assignments without errors or system crashes
data_to_capture: System resource utilization during peak load

test_steps.action: Monitor system performance metrics during and after the assignment process
test_steps.expected_result: System maintains acceptable performance levels with response times within expected thresholds

System response times remain within acceptable limits
No system crashes or unplanned downtime during test
Resource utilization returns to normal levels after test completion

Annex 11 - computerized systems should not be adversely affected by high load

No data loss during high-volume processing

test_cases.test_name: Large Dataset Report Generation Performance Test

test_steps.expected_result: Database contains the required 50,000+ records for testing

test_steps.action: Initiate generation of standard acknowledgment reports with filters set to include all 50,000+ records
test_steps.expected_result: Report generation process starts without errors

test_steps.action: Time the report generation process from initiation to completion using precise timing tools
test_steps.expected_result: Report generation completes successfully within 10 seconds
data_to_capture: System resource utilization during report generation

test_steps.action: Verify the generated report contains all expected data points and is formatted correctly
test_steps.expected_result: Report contains complete and accurate data for all 50,000+ records in the correct format

acceptance_criteria: Report generation completes in less than 10 seconds
All 50,000+ records are included in the report
Report data is accurate and complete
No system errors or timeouts during generation
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 - Requirements for electronic records and reports
Annex 11 - Performance requirements for computerized systems
data_integrity_requirements: Report data must match source database records exactly
No data truncation or corruption during report generation
All calculated fields must be accurate
